zh-CN.name: 弹弹play
zh-CN.configSchema.properties.baseUrl.title: 基础地址
zh-CN.configSchema.properties.baseUrl.descript: 弹弹play（或兼容）API 的根地址。默认为官方 https://api.dandanplay.net。指向代理或自建服务器即可覆盖。
zh-CN.configSchema.properties.appId.title: 应用 ID
zh-CN.configSchema.properties.appId.descriptio: 弹弹play 开放平台的 App ID。使用官方 API 时需填写；由代理在服务端签名时可留空。
zh-CN.configSchema.properties.appSecret.title: 应用密钥
zh-CN.configSchema.properties.appSecret.descri: 弹弹play 开放平台的 App Secret，用于对官方 API 的请求进行签名。
zh-CN.configSchema.properties.auth.title: 鉴权
zh-CN.configSchema.properties.auth.description: 随每个请求发送的自定义请求头（如 token）。未设置 appId/appSecret 时用于替代签名，例如对接自建的兼容服务器。
zh-CN.configSchema.properties.chConvert.title: 中文转换
zh-CN.configSchema.properties.chConvert.descri: 0 = 不转换，1 = 转为简体，2 = 转为繁体

baseUrl.title: Base URL
baseUrl.description: Root of the DanDanPlay (or compatible) API. Defaults to the official https://api.dandanplay.net. Point this at a proxy or self-hosted server to override.

appId.title: App ID
appId.description: DanDanPlay open-platform App ID. Required when using the official API; leave empty when a proxy signs requests server-side.

appSecret.title: App Secret
appSecret.description: DanDanPlay open-platform App Secret. Used to sign requests to the official API.

auth.title: Authentication
auth.description: Custom request headers (e.g. a token) sent on every request. Used instead of signing when appId/appSecret are absent, e.g. a self-hosted compatible server.

chConvert.title: Chinese conversion
chConvert.description: 0 = no conversion, 1 = convert to simplified, 2 = convert to traditional

values.req: ($base := baseUrl ? $replace(baseUrl, /\/$/, '') : 'https://api.dandanplay.net'; $p := '/api/v2/search/anime'; $ts := $string($now()); $headers := (appId and appSecret) ? { 'X-AppId': appId, 'X-Timestamp': $ts, 'X-Signature': $sha256Base64(appId & $ts & $p & appSecret) } : ((auth.enabled and auth.headers) ? $merge(auth.headers.{ key: value }) : {}); { 'url': $base & $p, 'headers': $headers })

search.output: [search.animes.{ 'providerIds': { 'animeId': animeId, 'bangumiId': bangumiId }, 'indexedId': $string(animeId), 'title': animeTitle, 'type': type, 'typeDescription': typeDescription, 'imageUrl': imageUrl, 'episodeCount': episodeCount, 'year': startDate and $contains(startDate, '-') ? $number($substringBefore(startDate, '-')) : undefined }]

values.req: ($base := baseUrl ? $replace(baseUrl, /\/$/, '') : 'https://api.dandanplay.net'; $p := '/api/v2/bangumi/' & $string(bangumiId); $ts := $string($now()); $headers := (appId and appSecret) ? { 'X-AppId': appId, 'X-Timestamp': $ts, 'X-Signature': $sha256Base64(appId & $ts & $p & appSecret) } : ((auth.enabled and auth.headers) ? $merge(auth.headers.{ key: value }) : {}); { 'url': $base & $p, 'headers': $headers })
